name: literature
description: Literature pack: verifies citations and resolves DOIs and arXiv IDs through the CiteNexus MCP server from the cite-nexus pack (key-free Crossref, DataCite, Europe PMC and arXiv), with an offline extractor for BibTeX and Markdown and a web_fetch fallback. Adds a hypothesis workflow: cited grounding, independent council proposals, a testability ranking and the smallest experiment per hypothesis, ending at the operator's own choice. Extends arxiv-literature. Needs network for every lookup.
